UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information including display name, avatar, and status.

isVerifiedCreator.description: True if the user has passed the Jimoh Jamihu security handshake.

isBanned.description: True if the user failed the security handshake.

ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A metadata record for a chat conversation.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a chat session.

imageUrl.description: Optional data URI of an image attached to the message.

StudioProject.title: StudioProject
StudioProject.description: A programmatic asset repository containing multiple files.

/users/{userId}.description: User profile settings including bio and roles.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Programmatic code repositories for the Jimskay Studio.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Metadata for a specific chat session.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Messages belonging to a specific chat session.
